name: toyota-monagas
description: Frontend build and release tooling for the Toyota Monagas WordPress theme.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:php && npm run lint:versions && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.package: npm run qa && node scripts/package-theme.mjs && npm run verify:release
scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run build
